items.html: When Adam haRishon was created and performed practical Mitzvot, he returned them face-to-face. In that state, there was no longer fear of the shells, as he had already dug, hoed, removed the stones, and cut the thorns from the vineyard. When they are back-to-back, ZON have only one wall for both of them. One wall is enough for both of them, and they use one wall: half a wall for ZA and half a wall for Nukva. When Adam returned them face-to-face through Mitzvot and good deeds, one posterior was finished and completed, one complete posterior for one, and one complete posterior for the other, and they can return to face-to-face.
